name: app-neo-brutalist-link-saver-app-yellow-pink-violet
title: Neo-Brutalist Link Saver App
whatItIs: A phone with a thick black outline and hard offset shadow on a yellow background with a pink circle and violet block, showing 'Save now. Find anytime.' with a paste field and plus button and six folder cards each with a coloured tab and icon.
whatItMeans: Thick outlines, hard shadows and saturated flat colours feel playful and tactile, like paper stickers.
techniques: Thick black outlines on every element
Hard offset shadows instead of blur

vocabulary.definition: A style using thick outlines, hard shadows and flat saturated colour.
A solid offset shadow with no blur.
A raised coloured tab on a card's top edge.
